summary: Sophie Lane called to add a second line for her home office at her address. The agent confirmed she was eligible and offered an extra twenty dollars per month plus free installation this month. They agreed on the same speed as her main line and scheduled the installation for Friday morning. Finally, Sophie thanked them for their assistance and ended the call with no further requests.

ratings.name: Branding and Survey
ratings.reason: The agent used the correct greeting and offered a post-call survey.

ratings.name: Personalized the Call
ratings.reason: – The agent correctly addressed Sophie by her name ("Sophie Lane") immediately.

ratings.name: Empathy and Acknowledgment
ratings.reason: – The agent acknowledged Sophie’s request to add a second line, showing understanding of her needs.

ratings.name: Rapport and Professionalism
ratings.reason: The agent maintained a polite tone throughout the conversation, avoiding interruptions or dismissive language.

ratings.name: Paraphrasing
ratings.reason: – The agent restated Sophie's request ("You want the same speed as your main line...") to confirm their understanding.

ratings.name: Verified Customer
ratings.reason: – The agent validated Sophie’s name and account details by confirming her identity.

ratings.name: Probing
ratings.reason: The agent asked clarifying questions about the office use case (“What will you be using it for?”) to understand the specific needs better.

ratings.name: Set Proper Expectations
ratings.reason: – The agent clearly outlined the cost, installation timeframe, and next steps (confirmation email).

ratings.name: Provided the Solution
ratings.reason: – The agent successfully set up the second line with the specified speed and configuration.

ratings.name: Took Ownership
ratings.reason: The agent took responsibility for resolving her request.

ratings.name: Active Listening
ratings.reason: – The agent listened attentively to Sophie’s needs without interrupting or offering unsolicited advice.

ratings.name: Confirmed Resolution
ratings.reason: – The agent confirmed that the issue was resolved ("You'll get a confirmation...") before closing.

compliance.name: Discourtesy
compliance.rule: Never be discourteous: no profanity, bashing, impatience, or sarcasm toward the customer

compliance.name: Escalation
compliance.rule: Escalate to a supervisor when the customer asks

compliance.name: Call Avoidance
compliance.rule: Do not avoid the call: never refuse to help or push the customer away without a valid reason

response_times.client_text: I want to add a second line for my home office.
response_times.agent_text: Happy to help with that. Let me verify your account first.
Thanks, Sophie. Let me check availability at your address for a second line.
You're eligible for a second line with its own router.
It's an extra twenty dollars a month, and installation is free this month.
Do you want the same speed as your main line, or something lighter for the office?
I'll set that up. The earliest install slot is Friday morning.
Booked. You'll get a confirmation and a reminder the day before.
You're welcome. Anything else I can help with today?

accuracy.matched_question: My internet is really slow lately.
accuracy.agent_answer: I'll set that up. The earliest install slot is Friday morning.
accuracy.ideal_answer: I'm sorry the speed has dropped. Let me run a line and speed test now to see what you're actually getting. If it's below your plan, I'll reset the line from our side or arrange a technician to fix it.
